|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">女預言者のいる場所で戦闘を宣言した場合、戦闘を開始する前に、どちらが勝つかを予測して相手に告げる（必ず行うこと）。戦闘の結果が予測どおりなら、君はロストしたカードを無作為に１枚、再使用できる。予測がはずれたなら、１フォースを失う。耐：損耗＜３。</span>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">名高い超能力者。凶運を察知する女性。タトゥイーンの統治者アリオンの使者。ハン・ソロに会うため、ドッキング・ベイ94に向かったジャバと手下どもの後をつけた。</span>''
|translation='''Title:''' Prophetess.

'''Card text:''' If you declare a battle where the Prophetess is, predict which side will win and tell the opponent before the battle starts; you must do this. If the outcome matches your prediction, you may randomly reuse one lost card. If the prediction is wrong, lose 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 3.

'''Lore:''' A renowned psychic who senses ill fortune, and an agent of Aryon, ruler of Tatooine. She followed Jabba and his subordinates to Docking Bay 94, where they went to meet Han Solo.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to tell the opponent the prediction and that a randomly selected lost card may be reused. The English requires a prediction and says to randomly retrieve one lost card. The Japanese lore says Jabba's party went to meet Han; the English says they confronted him.
